race.comment: DARNUM BEAR (3) was popular in betting last start but disappointed when 4 lengths away in sixth (20.16). Finished third the start before. Can make amends. SHIMA LITE (6) finds it hard to win. Better run when finding the frame last time though, finishing third (19.95) at this track. Form here at the trip sound including five wins. Expecting another good run. GO GO JEFF (1) was an impressive winner last time in quickest of the meeting when scoring by 2.75 lengths (19.75) at this track. Rates a leading chance again. SUPER SEALANT (8) didn't live up to the market support last time but should feature.
